powershell.ScriptContent:
#!/bin/bash
set -Eeuo pipefail

# PowerShell kommt als Snap (classic); hier nur die Postcondition und der Marker.

install_user="${1:-ubuntu}"
if ! getent passwd "$install_user" >/dev/null; then
    echo "Benutzer '$install_user' fehlt." >&2
    exit 1
fi

ln -sfn /snap/bin/pwsh /usr/local/bin/pwsh
sudo -u "$install_user" -H bash -c "pwsh -NoProfile -NonInteractive -Command '\$PSVersionTable.PSVersion.ToString()'"

install -d /var/lib/corebridge
touch /var/lib/corebridge/powershell.ready
